summary_md: **Taylor Christoffersen ([@TaylorChristof2](https://x.com/TaylorChristof2/status/2116547332825399759))** summarizes Ai2's research update finding LLM novelty judgments of research ideas unstable across prompts, and advises testing the judge on your own ideas ([Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?](https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/novelty-bench)).
